fusions.name: Torpor Cast
fusions.desc: Casts a cold link at the first enemy it meets that deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Stalled] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Stilling Coil
fusions.desc: Coils a ring of links around you that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns each for 1 second, leaving each [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Dead Still
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and you move 10% faster. Attacking breaks the veil.

fusions.name: Basking Weight
fusions.desc: In daylight, your armour rises by 12%.
